world_news.headline: Erin Patterson appeal live updates: Victorian woman loses bid to overturn triple-murder convictions over deadly mushroom-laced meal
world_news.summary:
Court of appeal ruling on the two appeals from 10am in the high profile Australian mushroom triple-murder case

  • Erin Patterson to learn if she could face retrial or longer jail term

Patterson’s actions mean it is ‘inappropriate’ to fix non-parole period, justice says

McLeish said the court had found Patterson’s actions “carefully planned and deliberate”, saying she had engaged in an “elaborate series of deceptions”.

The applicant’s murderous intent dated back to the invitations to lunch, it persisted through the lunch that the poison was administered …

We have concluded that the case involved such calculated criminality that it is inappropriate to fix a non-parole period.

world_news.headline: Netanyahu accused of smearing Arab voters to hold on to power
world_news.summary:
Prime minister claims Arab Israeli parties used foreign backing to steal elections, in which his coalition lost its majority

Benjamin Netanyahu has been accused of using smear tactics to cling to power, after he claimed that Arab Israeli parties had used foreign backing to “steal” Tuesday’s election, in which the prime minister’s coalition lost its parliamentary majority.

Netanyahu and his allies called on the internal security service, Shin Bet, to investigate alleged vote buying and other irregularities in Palestinian communities in Israel, supposedly funded by foreign money.

world_news.headline: More than half of Victorian lawyers use AI – but only a quarter have cut client fees as a result
world_news.summary:
Research finds 55% of lawyers are using AI in legal practices, up from 37% last year, though efficiency gains aren’t as high as expected

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

More than half of Victoria’s lawyers have reported using AI in their work, according to a new study, but just over a quarter say they’ve reduced fees as a result of efficiency gains.

They also say clients seeking advice from chatbots has added to their workload, forcing them to correct errors made by AI.
